name: Saw
overview: The biblical use of the saw is multifaceted, serving both practical and figurative purposes. It was employed as a brutal instrument of torture, as seen in Hebrews 11:37 where believers were 'sawn asunder,' and in 2 Samuel 12:31 where it was used in warfare and punishment. Additionally, saws were tools for precise craftsmanship, notably in cutting costly stones for the temple construction described in 1 Kings 7:9. Figuratively, Isaiah 10:15 uses the saw to illustrate the folly of pride, emphasizing that tools do not exalt themselves apart from their users, reminding us of God's sovereignty over all.
